After applying these three edits, you will have:

- `"cherow"` in the JS and JSX language definitions  
- A `parsers.cherow` getter that pulls in your Cherow-based parser implementation  

That lets Prettier pick `"cherow"` as a fast JS parser (you can now do `prettier --parser=cherow …`).
